text:
13 hours ago EDITOR’S NOTE: Send your Community Calendar items to Editor Chris Stiles at [email protected]. The Country Gentlemen Show, 7 p.m., March 12: The Carolina Civic Center Historic Theater presents the annual “Bluegrass on the Blackwater Concert” featuring The Country Gentlemen Show. Their harmonious blend of traditional and contemporary styles has made a lasting impact on the genre. Today, The Country Gentlemen Show, composed of talented musicians, carries the legacy of honoring the original band’s music and spirit. Read full article
